faq.question: Who is Jerome Arfouche?
faq.answer: Jerome Arfouche is a web developer from Montreal who designs and builds websites and apps, primarily using Laravel, Vue.js/Nuxt, and Kirby CMS.

faq.question: What technologies does Jerome work with?
faq.answer: Laravel, Vue.js/Nuxt, and Kirby CMS, along with REST APIs and general full-stack web development.

faq.question: What projects has Jerome built?
faq.answer: Projects include a minimalist weather app, a cycling workout tracker (Sprocket), a book release tracker (Imprint), a darkroom film development timer, and a photography site and print shop (The Invisible Cities).

faq.question: How can I contact Jerome?
faq.answer: Email hello@jerome-arfouche.com or find him on GitHub at github.com/hemorej.
